name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: ₹6,000 per year, paid as three instalments of ₹2,000 straight into the bank account.
summary: Income support for farmer families that own cultivable land.
note: Land must be in the applicant's name in state land records; e-KYC is mandatory.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
benefit: Crop insurance against drought, flood, pests and other losses. Farmer pays only 2% premium for kharif, 1.5% for rabi and 5% for commercial crops.
summary: Low-premium crop insurance for all farmers, including tenant farmers and sharecroppers, growing notified crops.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
benefit: Short-term crop loan at 7% interest, effectively 4% with prompt repayment, for seeds, fertiliser and other farm costs.
summary: Cheap working-capital credit for farmers, fishers and animal-husbandry farmers.

name: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana (farmer pension)
benefit: ₹3,000 monthly pension after age 60. You contribute ₹55 to ₹200 a month and the government matches it.
summary: Voluntary pension for small and marginal farmers aged 18-40 with up to 2 hectares (about 5 acres) of land.

name: PM-KUSUM (solar pump subsidy)
benefit: Up to 60% subsidy on a standalone solar irrigation pump, plus bank loan for a further 30%.
summary: Subsidised solar pumps for farmers so irrigation does not depend on diesel or grid power.

name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana - Per Drop More Crop
benefit: 55% subsidy for small and marginal farmers (45% for others) on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems.
summary: Micro-irrigation subsidy for farmers with their own or leased land.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana
benefit: 40% subsidy (60% for women and SC/ST) on boats, nets, ponds, cold storage and other fisheries assets.
summary: Financial support for fishers and fish farmers.

name: MGNREGA (100 days of guaranteed work)
benefit: At least 100 days of paid unskilled work per rural household every year, with wages paid into the bank account.
summary: Any adult in a rural household who is willing to do manual work can demand a job card and work.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
benefit: ₹1.20 lakh (₹1.30 lakh in hilly areas) to build a pucca house, plus MGNREGA wages and a toilet grant.
summary: Housing grant for rural families that are houseless or live in a kutcha house.
note: Beneficiaries are picked from the Awaas+ survey list and verified by the Gram Sabha.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban 2.0
benefit: Up to ₹2.5 lakh assistance to build or buy a house, or interest subsidy on a home loan.
summary: Housing support for urban families earning up to ₹9 lakh a year who do not own a pucca house anywhere in India.
documents: Land documents (if building on own land)

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY (health insurance)
name_hi: आयुष्मान भारत - प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
benefit: Free hospital treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at empanelled government and private hospitals.
summary: Cashless health cover for poor and vulnerable families, and for every citizen aged 70 or above regardless of income.
note: Family eligibility is based on the SECC list / state ration-card database - check with your Aadhaar on the portal.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (free ration)
benefit: 5 kg of free foodgrain per person every month (35 kg per family for Antyodaya cards).
summary: Free rice or wheat for families holding a priority or Antyodaya ration card.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (free LPG connection)
benefit: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove, plus a subsidy on each cylinder.
summary: Clean cooking gas for adult women of poor households that do not already have an LPG connection.
note: No other LPG connection should exist in the household.

name: PM SVANidhi (street vendor loan)
benefit: Collateral-free working-capital loan in three rising tranches (up to ₹50,000) with 7% interest subsidy and cashback on digital payments.
summary: Micro-credit for street vendors and hawkers in urban areas.
documents: Vending certificate / ID or letter of recommendation from the urban local body

name: PM Vishwakarma
benefit: ₹15,000 toolkit grant, skill training with ₹500 a day stipend, and loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest.
summary: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople in 18 trades such as carpenter, blacksmith, potter, tailor, cobbler, mason and barber.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
benefit: Collateral-free business loans: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (up to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (up to ₹10 lakh) and Tarun Plus (up to ₹20 lakh).
summary: Loans for small non-farm businesses such as shops, repair work, food stalls and small manufacturing.

name: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
benefit: 15% to 35% subsidy on the project cost of a new micro-enterprise (up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing, ₹20 lakh for services).
summary: Subsidy-linked bank loan for adults who want to start a new small business.
documents: Educational certificates (Class 8 pass for larger projects)

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (free skill training)
benefit: Free short-term skill training with a government-recognised certificate and placement help.
summary: Skill courses for youth aged 15-45 who are unemployed, school or college drop-outs, or want better jobs.

name: PM Internship Scheme
benefit: 12-month internship in a top company with ₹5,000 monthly stipend and a one-time ₹6,000 grant.
summary: Internships for youth aged 21-24 who are not in full-time work or study, from families earning up to ₹8 lakh a year.

name: e-Shram card
benefit: A national ID for unorganised workers with ₹2 lakh accident insurance and access to other welfare schemes.
summary: Registration for unorganised workers aged 16-59: labourers, vendors, domestic workers, gig workers and similar.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (worker pension)
benefit: ₹3,000 monthly pension after age 60. You contribute ₹55 to ₹200 a month and the government matches it.
summary: Voluntary pension for unorganised workers aged 18-40 earning up to ₹15,000 a month.

name: Building and Other Construction Workers welfare board
name_hi: भवन एवं अन्य सन्निर्माण कर्मकार कल्याण बोर्ड
benefit: Registered workers get education grants for children, maternity and medical aid, pension and accident cover (amounts vary by state).
summary: Welfare benefits for construction workers aged 18-60 who worked at least 90 days in the past year.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month after age 60, depending on your contribution.
summary: Pension scheme for any bank-account holder aged 18-40 who does not pay income tax.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (accident insurance)
benefit: ₹2 lakh cover for accidental death or full disability for a premium of just ₹20 a year.
summary: Accident insurance for any bank-account holder aged 18-70.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (life insurance)
benefit: ₹2 lakh life cover for a premium of ₹436 a year.
summary: Life insurance for any bank-account holder aged 18-50.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय वृद्धावस्था पेंशन योजना
benefit: Monthly pension: central share ₹200 (age 60-79) or ₹500 (80+); most states add their own top-up.
summary: Old-age pension for people aged 60 or above from below-poverty-line households.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय विधवा पेंशन योजना
benefit: Monthly pension: central share ₹300 (₹500 after age 80); most states add their own top-up.
summary: Pension for widows aged 40-79 from below-poverty-line households.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांग पेंशन योजना
benefit: Monthly pension: central share ₹300 (₹500 after age 80); most states add their own top-up.
summary: Pension for people aged 18-79 with 80% or more disability from below-poverty-line households.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID) card
benefit: A single nationwide disability certificate and ID that unlocks pensions, scholarships, travel concessions and reservations.
summary: Every person with a disability should get a UDID card first - most disability schemes ask for it.
documents: Existing disability certificate or medical records

name: ADIP scheme (free aids and appliances)
benefit: Free wheelchairs, tricycles, hearing aids, artificial limbs and similar aids (full subsidy if monthly income is up to ₹22,500).
summary: Assistive devices for people with 40% or more disability.

name: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana
benefit: Free walking sticks, hearing aids, spectacles, dentures and wheelchairs for senior citizens.
summary: Assistive devices for citizens aged 60+ who are BPL or have a monthly income up to ₹15,000.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: High-interest (about 8.2%) tax-free savings account for a daughter; deposit ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh a year, matures when she turns 21.
summary: Savings account that parents open at a post office or bank for a girl child below 10 years of age.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana
benefit: ₹5,000 in instalments for the first child, and ₹6,000 if the second child is a girl.
summary: Maternity benefit for pregnant women and new mothers.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana
benefit: Cash help for delivering in a government or accredited hospital (about ₹1,400 rural / ₹1,000 urban in high-focus states).
summary: Cash incentive for pregnant women, especially from poor, SC and ST families, to deliver in a hospital.

name: DAY-NRLM self-help groups
name_hi: दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण आजीविका मिशन
benefit: Join a women's self-help group for a revolving fund, low-interest bank loans (up to ₹20 lakh per group) and livelihood training.
summary: Savings-and-credit groups for rural women from poor households.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC students (Class 9-10)
benefit: About ₹3,500 a year for day scholars and ₹7,000 for hostellers.
summary: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students in Class 9 and 10 with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC students
benefit: Full compulsory fees plus an academic allowance of ₹2,500 to ₹13,500 a year depending on the course.
summary: Scholarship for Scheduled Caste students from Class 11 up to PhD with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for ST students (Class 9-10)
benefit: About ₹225 a month for day scholars and ₹525 for hostellers, plus a books grant.
summary: Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students in Class 9 and 10 with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for ST students
benefit: Full compulsory fees plus a monthly maintenance allowance.
summary: Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe students from Class 11 onwards with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: PM YASASVI scholarship (OBC / EBC / DNT)
benefit: About ₹4,000 a year in Class 9-10, and ₹5,000 to ₹20,000 a year for post-matric courses.
summary: Scholarship for OBC, economically backward and de-notified tribe students from Class 9 onwards with family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities (Class 9-10)
benefit: Admission and tuition fee support plus a maintenance allowance.
summary: Scholarship for Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain and Parsi students in Class 9-10 with family income up to ₹1 lakh and 50% marks.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
benefit: Course fee support plus a monthly maintenance allowance.
summary: Scholarship for minority-community students from Class 11 onwards with family income up to ₹2 lakh and 50% marks.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
benefit: ₹12,000 a year from Class 9 to Class 12.
summary: Scholarship for students of government and aided schools with family income up to ₹3.5 lakh, selected through a state exam held in Class 8.
note: The selection test is written in Class 8; students already selected renew every year on the National Scholarship Portal.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship for College Students
benefit: ₹12,000 a year during graduation and ₹20,000 a year at postgraduate level.
summary: Scholarship for college students who scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12 and have family income up to ₹4.5 lakh.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girls
benefit: ₹50,000 a year for every year of the course.
summary: Scholarship for girls studying a technical degree or diploma in an AICTE-approved institution, family income up to ₹8 lakh.
note: Only for technical courses (engineering, pharmacy, architecture and similar); up to two girls per family.

name: Scholarships for Students with Disabilities
benefit: Maintenance allowance, book grant and disability allowance; fees reimbursed for post-matric and top-class courses.
summary: Pre-matric (Class 9-10) and post-matric scholarships for students with 40% or more disability and family income up to ₹2.5 lakh.

name: PM Vidyalaxmi (education loan)
benefit: Collateral-free, guarantor-free education loan, with 3% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹10 lakh for family income up to ₹8 lakh.
summary: Education loans for students admitted to top-ranked higher-education institutions.
